commitments.commitment: Zero-shot evaluation of **all** models on the secondary dataset; compare attention maps with visible symptoms
commitments.document_status: 🟡 2026-11-21 first half done: all 130 round-models (11 headline methods and 9 Stage 5 conditions, 5 rounds each) scored zero-shot on Paddy Doctor, `docs/reports/paddy_report.md`; H3 not shown. The comparison of attention maps with visible symptoms (Stage 12, 2026-11-21, `docs/reports/explain_report.md`): 50 blind heat maps rated by three disclosed model raters, yes 39.3%, partly 32.0%, no 28.7%, all agree on 88.0% (Fleiss' kappa 0.88); deletion test on test photos shows the attended tiles matter (gap 25.4 points at k=16, both ranges); on Paddy photos the effect is small (2.2 points, photo range only). 🟢 second half done with model raters (human raters not used)
